items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: He said, no, but he's shooting, Rowling.

ctx.x: I played in Cessna for you playing in there.

Yeah, and some fella you knew from in the district, you see, an old fella, and they got to talking from back there in, what's that man here, Billy Phillips and them, talking about Billy Phillips and all of them? About the old cabaret and everything happening in the district. So this guy had a mix up with someone, one of the boys down there bought the light, and the dynamo used to keep the supply of the light, and they had a mix up with that. And this fella, man, was half drunk and he'd come shooting through the…
